title: Muryar Tsayayye
intro: Ana tuna wannan mutum da hikima da ja-gora mai zurfi, yana ba da shawara da ta wuce tsararraki. Kalmominsu shaida ne ga taƙawa da kuma muhimmancin gane albarka da jarabawa daga Allah. Gano asalin wannan ruhi mai daraja.
clues: Ban kasance annabi ba, amma hikimata ta tabbata a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki.
Shawarata ga ɗana ta jaddada godiya ga Allah da kuma guje wa shirka.
Na koyar game da muhimmancin addu'a, umarni da alheri, da kuma hani daga mummuna.
Na yi gargaɗi game da girman kai da tafiya da girman kai a duniya.
Sunana ya samo asali ne daga wani babi a cikin Alqur'ani, wanda ke nuna koyarwar da nake koyarwa.
Shawarata ta haɗa da haƙuri a cikin mawuyacin hali, domin hakika, hakan yana daga cikin mafi kyawun al'amura.

trial.label: Koyarwa/Jagora Mai Muhimmanci
options: Bayar da hikima da shawara kan ɗabi'a
trial.answer: Bayar da hikima da shawara kan ɗabi'a

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An rubuta hikimarsa a cikin Alqur'ani
Ya jagoranci mutanensa zuwa sabuwar ƙasa
An ba shi dukiya mai yawa
outcome.answer: An rubuta hikimarsa a cikin Alqur'ani

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
